headline: BTC stalls below key resistance as liquidity hunt intensifies
market_phase: Consolidation with liquidity hunt near resistance
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming a descending channel, holding the 84.8k support while testing the 86.2k resistance; 4H shows a flat range, indicating sellers are probing liquidity before a breakout.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑beta alts, with NMR, ORCA and MAGIC leading gains, suggesting risk‑on sentiment despite Bitcoin’s sideways stance.
strategy_outlook: Enter spot BTC short or futures sell‑stop at 86,200 with a tight 500‑point profit target; consider long positions on top‑gaining alts on breakouts above their daily highs.
